notes: Every mcp__* tool denies while pending: the hook cannot know what an MCP server will write, so there is no target to compare against the allow-list. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
